bb.name: Orbit
bb.description: A live map of every thread across bb. Today's front desk sits in the middle, each section is a system round it with its pinned hub as the anchor, and child threads circle their parents. A thread that's working glows, each tool call sends out a ripple with the tool's name, a hand-off between threads flies across as a comet, and a thread asking you pings amber. Beside the map: what each working thread is doing now, with its model and context used, a feed of tool calls and hand-offs, and tool calls a minute over the last hour. Click a thread to open it, Cmd-click for a split. It reads bb's own thread list and event log, only while the page is showing, and starts no agent turns.
